name: P. Tang
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve slicked-back hair, amber glasses, red/yellow coat with black fur, yellow trousers, two-tone shoes and studded leather belt. Existing buckle artwork stays a physical reference detail; no added gold-fist effect. Review belt topology, huge distance change, target-only contact and full-body end pose.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns. Use character-specific effects and props; do not add a recurring golden-fist emblem or generic fist-shaped power effect.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

P. Tang — Belt Check.
IDENTITY: exact lean muscular adult brown-skinned man with slicked-back black hair, thin mustache and goatee, amber rectangular sunglasses, white-bead necklace, open red-and-yellow long coat with enormous black fur collar and cuffs, bright yellow flared trousers and black/white dress shoes. Preserve his long dark brown studded leather belt and its existing large oval buckle as a physical prop detail. Keep the original character and costume, no added fist-shaped power effect.
0–1.2s: full-body low-angle establishment. He draws the studded belt taut once between his hands, tilts the amber glasses down a fraction, then launches the buckle end forward with an elegant wrist snap. A huge charcoal padded training dummy hangs far ahead in empty cyan.
1.2–3.2s: camera accelerates along the flying buckle and pulls way back: the leather belt stretches into a tremendous curling loop across thirty feet of empty space while he remains a small complete figure at its origin. The buckle whips around the dummy and the belt catches it around its padded middle. Show ONE continuous belt from his hand to the target, no duplicated straps, hands or unexplained cuts.
3.2–4.8s: he pivots sharply and yanks. The enormous dummy swings toward him in a spectacular rising arc; he ducks beneath it and reverses the belt with a full-body backhand SNAP, sending the dummy hurtling away in the opposite direction. One colossal bounded ivory/red impact crescent and a hard contact hold at the reversal. Camera races with the target as it shrinks into the far cyan distance, belt releasing cleanly. This is an exaggerated prop stunt; no human opponent or injury.
4.8–6s: snap-zoom back to his composed face as the belt recoils in one clean spiral into his palm. Exact title BELT CHECK slams below his glasses with a heavy leather-and-metal impact. Black fur and coat tails settle without swallowing the background.
6–8s: whole-character hero hold, belt casually draped over his shoulder, entire silhouette framed on cyan. One tiny tuft of dummy stuffing lands on his yellow trouser leg. He brushes it off with two fingers, then nudges his glasses back up. SFX: leather tension creak, fast buckle whistle, enormous swinging air rush, dominant whip CRACK with deep padded hit, receding target whoosh, retracting belt flutter, title slam and tiny glasses click. No music, speech, scenery or floor.
